text: create for me a end to end guide in a single file html document
resolution: Created docs/game/CHARACTER_RIG_GUIDE.html as a single self-contained, responsive, printable end-to-end guide for the current cart/editor character-rig workflow. It covers arbitrary imported/existing models, BODY connectivity repair, complete semantic anatomy assignment, skeleton fitting and manual sizing, binding, heatmap/probe and bend tests, save/cold-reopen durability, export-time Player/NPC role selection, invalidation rules, readiness blockers, undo/redo ownership, and current UI constraints. Validated tag balance, unique IDs, all internal anchors, required workflow coverage, no external scripts/assets/network references, and git diff cleanliness.
